items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: I remember, 1901 when Jack Dawson lied on to just work up in 91. But I wasn't involved in long before then

ctx.x: April 30th. Yeah. And when did you go to New Orleans?

When you're alone, you have to answer all the time. Oh, yeah, that's right. I remember, 1901 when Jack Dawson lied on to just work up in 91. But I wasn't involved in long before then, but I can't remember what year it was.
Long before 1901. What was your first instrument? What did you start to play? My first instrument was a guitar. A guitar.
